#   grep -ohE '^(Fly|Render|Sky)\.\w+ =' lib/{Fly,Render,Sky}.js; grep -ohE '^FlyThrough\.\w+ =' FlyThrough.js
# then stripped of ' =' and sorted (LC_ALL=C sort -u). One qualified JS name per line.
